Returning five to eight creates a new outer-seat object with the same number. The current conversion and target still enable confirmation, the retired target cannot deselect it, and current toggle/cancel clear _selectedTargetSeat.
Existing pointer-overlap, right-click cancel, quick equipment confirmation, privacy, cache identity, unchanged-control layout and current exact-rule submission checks remain.
